source_metadata.title: In vivo acquired daptomycin resistance during treatment of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: The report describes emergence of daptomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus during daptomycin treatment of right-sided infective endocarditis in a patient with no prior vancomycin treatment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This clinical case reports the emergence of a daptomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolate during daptomycin treatment in a patient with right-sided infective endocarditis who had never been treated with vancomycin.

atoms.canonical_statement: The patient was a 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease who was hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and required mechanical ventilation in the intensive care unit.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease was hospitalized for an acute respiratory decompensation. The patient was immediately transferred to the intensive care unit where mechanical ventilation was established.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: Before the observed emergence of daptomycin resistance, the patient had not been treated with vancomycin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: who had never been treated with vancomycin

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

exposures.details: No prior treatment before the observed emergence of daptomycin resistance

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 52, daptomycin 7 mg/kg was started for MRSA catheter-related bacteremia associated with hypovolemia.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At day 52 post-hospitalization, daptomycin treatment (7 mg/kg) was started for an MRSA catheter-related bacteremia associated with hypovolemia.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: Minimum inhibitory concentrations for the representative S. aureus isolates were determined by E-test and broth dilution and interpreted using EUCAST guidelines.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) were determined using the E-test and broth dilution methods, and interpreted as susceptible (S) or resistant (R) in accordance with EUCAST guidelines.

atoms.canonical_statement: Across three representative blood isolates, the daptomycin MIC increased from 0.25 mg/L (S1) to 0.75 mg/L (S2) and then to 2 mg/L (S3), with S3 interpreted as daptomycin-resistant.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Daptomycin 0.25 (S), 0.75 (S), 2 (R)

population.label: Three representative MRSA Staphylococcus aureus blood-culture isolates (S1, S2, S3) from the same patient

exposures.details: Serial treatment exposure; 7 mg/kg initially, then 16 mg/kg/day after persistent bacteremia

atoms.canonical_statement: Across isolates S1, S2, and S3, the vancomycin MICs were 0.75, 1, and 1.5 mg/L, respectively, and all were interpreted as susceptible.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Vancomycin 0.75 (S), 1 (S), 1.5 (S)

population.label: Three representative MRSA Staphylococcus aureus blood-culture isolates (S1, S2, S3) from the same patient

exposures.details: Serial isolates collected over the daptomycin treatment course

atoms.canonical_statement: The linezolid MIC was 0.38 mg/L in each of isolates S1, S2, and S3, with all three interpreted as susceptible.

population.label: Three representative MRSA Staphylococcus aureus blood-culture isolates (S1, S2, S3) from the same patient

exposures.details: Serial isolates collected over the daptomycin treatment course

atoms.canonical_statement: Rifampin susceptibility changed from MIC 0.006 mg/L in S1 and S2 to MIC >32 mg/L with resistance in S3.

population.label: Three representative MRSA Staphylococcus aureus blood-culture isolates (S1, S2, S3) from the same patient

exposures.details: Added after persistent bacteremia during high-dose daptomycin treatment

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 60, transesophageal echocardiography showed a 1.5-cm vegetation on the tricuspid valve.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: On day 60, a transesophageal echocardiogram (TEE) showed a 1.5-cm vegetation on the tricuspid valve.

atoms.canonical_statement: After 8 days of daptomycin treatment, blood cultures remained positive.

atoms.canonical_statement: Because bacteremia persisted and the daptomycin MIC had risen to 0.75 mg/L, daptomycin was increased to 16 mg/kg/day and rifampin 1200 mg/day was added.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Consequently, the daptomycin dose was increased to 16 mg/kg/day and associated with rifampin (1200 mg/day) for possible synergy.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: Despite an additional 8 days of daptomycin 16 mg/kg/day plus rifampin 1200 mg/day, bacteremia persisted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Despite additional 8 days of this therapy, the bacteremia persisted

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 68, therapy was switched to vancomycin 3 g/day by continuous infusion, gentamicin 4 mg/kg/day, and linezolid 1200 mg/day.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At 68 days of hospitalization, the antibiotic treatment was switched to a combination of vancomycin (3 g/day continuous infusion), gentamicin (4 mg/kg/day), and linezolid (1200 mg/day).

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: After the switch to vancomycin, gentamicin, and linezolid, blood cultures remained negative.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: From then, blood cultures remained negative.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

atoms.canonical_statement: Gentamicin was stopped after 5 days, linezolid after 12 days, and vancomycin was continued for 6 weeks with measured blood concentrations between 25 and 35 mg/L.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Gentamicin and linezolid were discontinued after 5 days and 12 days, respectively (Figure 1). Vancomycin was continued for 6 weeks, with controls of blood concentrations showing values remaining between 25 and 35 mg/l.

population.label: 55-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease hospitalized for acute respiratory decompensation and subsequently treated for MRSA bacteremia/right-sided infective endocarditis

exposures.details: Measured blood concentrations remained between 25 and 35 mg/L

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 113, transesophageal echocardiography showed that the tricuspid vegetation had decreased to 1.2 cm.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At this stage (day 113), TEE revealed a slight decrease in the vegetation (1.2 cm).

atoms.canonical_statement: Comparison of the pretreatment daptomycin-susceptible isolate with the daptomycin-resistant isolate did not detect mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG except for a single rpoB-region mutation described as conferring rifampin resistance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A comparison of our daptomycin-susceptible isolate (pre-treatment) and the daptomycin-resistant strain did not detect mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, and yycG genes, except a single mutation within the region of the rpoB gene known to confer resistance to rifampin.

population.label: Three representative MRSA Staphylococcus aureus blood-culture isolates (S1, S2, S3) from the same patient

concept.text: detected mutations in candidate resistance genes

atoms.canonical_statement: The molecular mechanism responsible for the observed daptomycin resistance was not determined.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The molecular mechanism of this daptomycin resistance trait remains to be determined.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that this was, to their knowledge, the first clinical case of de novo daptomycin resistance with failure to cure MRSA endocarditis during therapy without prior vancomycin exposure and without newly detected mutations in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To the best of our knowledge, this clinical case is the first regarding the de novo development of daptomycin resistance with clinical failure to cure MRSA during endocarditis therapy, without previous treatment with vancomycin and without any de novo mutation in mprF, rpoB, rpoC, or yycG genes.
